newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Trans-Caledon sets 200 mln rand 3-yr floating note.
newsitem.headline: Trans-Caledon sets 200 mln rand 3-yr floating note.

text.p: Trans-Caledon Tunnel Authority has placed a 200 million rand three-year floating rate note, lead manager Standard Corporate and Merchant Bank said on Thursday.
The issue date is June 30, 1997, and the note matures on June 30, 2000.

The note bears interest at SAFEX BA (converted to yield) minus 0.05 percent calculated by the paying agent and payable quarterly in arrears each June 30, September 30, December 30 and March 30, commencing September 30, 1997, and subject to modified business day convention.
The issue is fully guaranteed by the government of South Africa.
